'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***A child is killed and six people are wounded in a Russian missile strike on [[Kostiantynivka]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/25/russia-ukraine-war-at-a-glance-what-we-know-on-day-517-of-the-invasion (''The Guardian'')]
***Dylan Collins, a journalist for [[Agence France-Presse]], is wounded in [[Bakhmut]] by a Russian [[drone attack]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/25/russia-ukraine-war-at-a-glance-what-we-know-on-day-517-of-the-invasion (''The Guardian'')]
**[[2022–2023 Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] attack [[Odesa Oblast]] with [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]], destroying grain warehouses at the [[Reni Commercial Seaport]] and injuring seven [[civilian]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-attack-odesa-destroys-grains-depot-injures-four-ukraine-military-2023-07-24/ (Reuters)]
**[[2022–2023 western Russia attacks]]
***Two [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|drones]] damage buildings in [[Moscow]], including one near the [[Main Building of the Ministry of Defense (Russia)|Defence Ministry headquarters]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/drone-fragments-found-near-russias-defence-ministry-building-central-moscow-2023-07-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Mogadishu military academy bombing]]
***An [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] [[Suicide attack|suicide bomber]] blows himself up at a [[military academy]] in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]], killing over 20 [[Somali Armed Forces|soldiers]] and injuring dozens more. [https://www.dw.com/en/somalia-al-shabab-islamist-kills-dozens-in-attack-on-army/a-66333884 (DW)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[GAC Toyota]], a [[subsidiary]] of [[Toyota]], announces that they have cut off 1,000 jobs from [[China]]. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Business/Automobiles/Toyota-slashes-1-000-jobs-at-operations-in-China (Nikkei Asia)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 North Africa wildfires]]
**Thirty-four people are killed, 26 others are injured, and thousands more are [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] during [[wildfire]]s in [[Algeria]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230724-algeria-fires-fanned-by-winds-extreme-heat-kill-34-1 (AFP via France 24)]
*In [[Indonesia]], at least 15 people are killed and 33 others are rescued after a [[ferry]] traveling from [[Buton]] to [[Muna Island|Muna]] [[Capsizing|capsizes]] off the coast of [[Sulawesi]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20230724-at-least-15-killed-19-missing-after-ferry-sinks-off-coast-of-indonesian-island (AFP via France 24)]
*At least 14 people are killed when a [[pirogue]] capsizes off the coast of [[Dakar]], [[Senegal]]. [https://www.channelstv.com/2023/07/24/boat-capsizes-killing-14-off-senegal-capital/ (AFP via Channels TV)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Algeria]], [[Foreign relations of Denmark]], [[Foreign relations of Sweden]]
**[[2023 Quran desecration in Sweden]]
***The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Algeria)|Algerian foreign ministry]] summons [[Denmark|Danish]] ambassador [[Ole Wøhlers Olsen]] and the [[Sweden|Swedish]] [[chargé d'affaires]] following a series of protests involving [[Quran desecration]] in [[Copenhagen]] and [[Stockholm]]. [https://english.news.cn/20230725/14156107b63b414e9beb40b4c7b760d7/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[Mali–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] announces sanctions on three senior [[Mali]]an officials, including the country's Defence Minister [[Sadio Camara]], for allegedly "helping to facilitate" the presence of the Russian [[paramilitary]] [[Wagner Group]] in the country. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/7/24/us-sanctions-malis-defence-minister-officials-over-wagner-ties (Al Jazeera)]
*[[North Korea–United States relations]], [[North Korea–South Korea relations]], [[South Korea–United States relations]]
**[[North Korea]] shoots two [[ballistic missile]]s into a sea, hours after the arrival of [[USS Annapolis (SSN-760)|USS ''Annapolis'']] at a port on [[South Korea]]'s [[Jeju Island]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/24/north-korea-fires-missiles-sea-us-submarine-south-annapolis (AP via ''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Israeli judicial reform]]
**The [[Knesset]] votes 64–0, with the 56-member opposition [[boycott]]ing, to approve a law that prevents the [[Supreme Court of Israel|Supreme Court]] from overturning government decisions on the basis of "reasonableness." [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israels-netanyahu-discharged-hospital-reuters-witness-says-2023-07-24/ (Reuters)]
*The United States [[United States Department of Justice|justice department]] files a lawsuit against the state of [[Texas]] for placing buoys in the [[Rio Grande]] as part of [[Operation Lone Star|the state's effort to deter migrants from crossing into the United States]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/immigration/texas-gov-greg-abbott-promises-legal-battle-river-buoys-doj-warns-will-rcna95979 (NBC News)]
*Indian police arrest 74 [[Rohingya refugees in India|Rohingya refugees]], including ten [[Minor (law)|minors]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/indian-police-arrest-74-rohingya-refugees-north-2023-07-24/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/7/25/india-police-arrest-seventy-four-rohingya-in-latest-crackdown-on-refugees (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Minister of Justice (New Zealand)|New Zealand justice minister]] [[Kiri Allan]] [[resign]]s following [[criminal charge|charges]] of [[careless driving]] and [[Refusing to assist a police officer|refusal to accompany police]] after an [[Driving under the influence|alcohol-related car accident]]. [https://apnews.com/article/new-zealand-justice-minister-resigns-kiri-allan-86a459a51664aad786dd96976fbbc8c8 (AP)]
